thread.title: Wall Street Wobbles Into Close as Energy Weighs, Tech Slips

title: Wall Street Wobbles Into Close as Energy Weighs, Tech Slips
text:
Wall Street Wobbles Into Close as Energy Weighs, Tech Slips April 27, 2018, 03:58:13 PM EDT By MT Newswires, MT Newswires Shutterstock photo
Wall Street wobbled toward the close on Friday with the benchmarks posting slim moves in mixed directions as earnings from Exxon Mobil ( XOM ) weighed on the blue-chip Dow Jones Industrial Average and sent the S&P's energy group sliding.
Stocks were choppy this week as investors watched quarterly earnings roll in, with results from top tech names cheered before jitters emerged in the group ahead of Apple's ( AAPL ) report. Economic data also weighed with the growth in the U.S. slowing on a quarterly basis while worries rose over wage inflation.
